words.sense: Regularly moving between sites as part of a professional working life, especially among academics or consultants.
misconceptions: Any traveler who changes locations is necessarily peripatetic.

words.sense: Traveling from place to place, especially to carry out practical jobs in successive locations.
words.connotation: neutral; sometimes suggests insecure or temporary work
misconceptions: A professional who rotates through workplaces must be described as itinerant.

semantic_axes.description: Whether travel is built into a specialist career or serves practical work.
Whether sites are part of an ongoing professional circuit or successive short jobs.

edges.boundary_rule: Peripatetic emphasizes a professional career spread across work sites, whereas itinerant emphasizes traveling between places to carry out practical work.
clues_a: a specialist visits different offices each week
a teacher rotates among schools as their job
a consultant moves among client sites
clues_b: earns a living at a succession of temporary stalls
travels house to house making repairs

misconceptions.M1: Any traveler who changes locations is necessarily peripatetic.
misconceptions.M2: A professional who rotates through workplaces must be described as itinerant.
misconceptions.M3: A long journey alone determines which word fits.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Salma’s working life?

beats.text: Salma teaches literature at three colleges, spending a fixed day at each every week.
beats.decisive_clue: a lecturer rotates regularly among colleges
beats.reason: Her professional teaching is deliberately spread across campuses.

beats.text: Her lectures and student meetings follow the same circuit every term.
beats.decisive_clue: the college circuit is part of her academic career
beats.reason: The repeated teaching circuit confirms a mobile professional role, not a sequence of temporary odd jobs.

chains.feedback_short: The repeated teaching circuit confirms a mobile professional role, not a sequence of temporary odd jobs.
chains.feedback_deep: Her professional teaching is deliberately spread across campuses. The repeated teaching circuit confirms a mobile professional role, not a sequence of temporary odd jobs. Peripatetic highlights the mobile professional; itinerant highlights work done place to place.
chains.contrast_rule: Peripatetic highlights the mobile professional; itinerant highlights work done place to place.

hints.attention: Consider what kind of work requires the travel.

hints.contrast: Peripatetic highlights the mobile professional; itinerant highlights work done place to place.
